title: Implement: Python oracle for Transport Protocol
description: Write reference implementation in python/src/lichen/. Must be clear, readable, well-commented. Cover all MUST requirements.
close_reason: Already implemented. Python oracle for Transport Protocol exists across: (1) lichen/coap/params.py - CongestionLevel enum, congestion_level(), check_congestion_allows(), congestion_service_unavailable() for duty cycle and 5.03 responses; (2) lichen/coap/transport.py - DatagramChannel with congestion checking; (3) lichen/schc/fragment.py - MAX_SCHC_PACKET=1281. All MUST requirements from spec 07 sections 9-10 are covered with comprehensive tests in tests/coap/test_congestion.py.
